_comment: Per-site SQL shapes for AssertGoldenShapes (shapes.go), plan 7.2 Layer 1
extended for sites kept raw as "runtime-varying: the statement has more
than one possible rendered form" (tools/orm-migration/keep-raw.json). A
single goldenSql cannot describe such a site; this lists every SQL form
its ORIGINAL raw-SQL code could produce, derived from that code's own
branching (a switch case, a map key, an if/else arm), not from the
conversion. AssertGoldenShapes fails unless a site's conversion test
covers every shape declared here, and only those.
Declarative, like keep-raw.json and approved-diffs.json: the expected SQL
for each shape is recorded here for review, not asserted by whoever wrote
the conversion - a test that supplies both the expected SQL and the code
producing it proves only that the two agree with each other.
Lives in this package (ormharness), unlike keep-raw.json and
approved-diffs.json which live in tools/orm-migration: it is embedded the
same way manifest.json is (see embeddedManifest in golden.go) - the apiv2
container mounts iznik-server-go as /app, so nothing outside that
directory exists at runtime, and go:embed cannot reach outside its own
package directory regardless of where the file lived.
